items.title: Elvin Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Donald Byrd and all these guys. They’d get a gig and call me up.

ctx.x: Okay so that takes up through that very historical recording, Live Village Vanguard. That brings us to November 1957. I know that date, that’s up here. Elvin Jones Sonny Rollins Live at Village Vanguard November 1957. What happens after that? Cause I have the Jones—“Keeping up with the Joneses” and this is not long after, this is March of ‘58. As a matter of fact I bought it March 24th of this year. So did you make any other recordings other than the Vanguard recording, which you didn’t know was going to be a…
Well I don’t recall doing any. I know I played with other people cause Pepper Adams was in town, Donald Byrd and all these guys. They’d get a gig and call me up. It was like that.
So the folks from Detroit, you guys kept in touch?
